  886 Battle::AbilityEffects::MoveBlocking.add(:DAZZLING,
  887   proc { |ability, bearer, user, targets, move, battle|
  888     next false if battle.choices[user.index][4] <= 0
  889     next false if !bearer.opposes?(user)
  890     ret = false
  891     targets.each { |b| ret = true if b.opposes?(user) }
  892     next ret
  893   }
  894 )

  902 Battle::AbilityEffects::MoveImmunity.add(:BULLETPROOF,
  903   proc { |ability, user, target, move, type, battle, show_message|
  904     next false if !move.bombMove?
  905     if show_message
  906       battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(target)
  907       if Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH
  908         battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("It doesn't affect {1}...", target.pbThis(true)))
  909       else
  910         battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s {2} made {3} ineffective!",
  911            target.pbThis, target.abilityName, move.name))
  912       end
  913       battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(target)
  914     end
  915     next true
  916   }
  917 )
  918 
  919 Battle::AbilityEffects::MoveImmunity.add(:FLASHFIRE,
  920   proc { |ability, user, target, move, type, battle, show_message|
  921     next false if user.index == target.index
  922     next false if type != :FIRE
  923     if show_message
  924       battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(target)
  925       if !target.effects[PBEffects::FlashFire]
  926         target.effects[PBEffects::FlashFire] = true
  927         if Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH
  928           battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("The power of {1}'s Fire-type moves rose!", target.pbThis(true)))
  929         else
  930           battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("The power of {1}'s Fire-type moves rose because of its {2}!",
  931              target.pbThis(true), target.abilityName))
  932         end
  933       elsif Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH
  934         battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("It doesn't affect {1}...", target.pbThis(true)))
  935       else
  936         battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s {2} made {3} ineffective!",
  937                                target.pbThis, target.abilityName, move.name))
  938       end
  939       battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(target)
  940     end
  941     next true
  942   }
